resize_aspect_ratio_relative: resize an image to a new width based on a relative aspect ratio while keeping height unchanged
resize_aspect_ratio_absolute: resize an image to an absolute aspect ratio while preserving the original image area
test_aspect_ratio_rel: test the aspect_ratio_rel function by resizing a numpy image array with a given aspect ratio
test_aspect_ratio_abs: test the aspect_ratio_abs function by resizing a numpy image array to a target aspect ratio
summarize_image_helpers: summarize the image helper functions for width-relative and absolute aspect ratio transformations
